$doc: Layout widths (design/ui.md). split is SPLIT_MIN_WIDTH: at or over it the list and the open task sit side by side; under it they stack. CSS media queries can't read variables, so the kit's lint allows these px values in @media and @container conditions only. box-narrow is a container width, not the window's: v1's prompt box folds its toolbar to icons under it (@container launcher). box-tight, box-roomy and box-wide are the prompt box's other folds (v1 launcher.css), pane-wide the main pane's width from which the task's details sit in a column beside it (v1 split.js DETAILS_PANE). pane-xs: under it a task's details put the branch on its own line. box-xs: under it the prompt box's location row folds No folder to its icon.
